clips.title: The story
paras: Beside the Tidus Stair, respected tauren shaman Islen Waterseer guides Horde initiates through the trials of water. She lives by a quiet fishing hut and teaches shamans to attune to water spirits as they seek their Water Totem.

On the Barrens coast, Islen Waterseer keeps to the craggy Tidus Stair, where arid plains meet the Great Sea. Water spirits are raw and near along this shore. Islen chooses this quiet outpost over thunderous halls and busy cities, spending her days listening to the tides. Shamans seeking communion with water come to her for guidance.

To know water, a shaman needs inner harmony and spiritual sight as well as study. Islen guides seekers in preparing the Water Sapta, a sacred brew that pierces the veil between mortal senses and elemental manifestations. She teaches that water can be unyielding and deep, yet fluid and restorative. Anyone who calls on its aid must show it great respect.

Though Islen lives quietly on the coast, her spiritual ties reach across Kalimdor. She shares a close, enduring friendship with Greta Mosshoof, another wise tauren skilled in the restorative arts. Islen's knowledge of water's purifying nature reaches beyond the Barrens, bringing spiritual aid to lands afflicted by deep corruption.
